newsitem.title: USA: IMF says Thailand program not under discussion now.
newsitem.headline: IMF says Thailand program not under discussion now.

text.p: The International Monetary Fund is in close contact with the authorities in Thailand, but there have been no negotiations on a new program, an IMF spokesperson said on Friday.
"No negotiations on a program for Thailand have started so far. The IMF is in close contact with the Thai authorities," the spokesperson said.

Thai officials, speaking after they reluctantly floated the baht currency, have said Thailand hopes to raise $10 billion to replenish reserves depleted as speculators attacked the baht and ease a likely credit crunch.

The baht crisis has had a knock-on effect elsewhere in the region. The Philippines floated the peso on Friday and Indonesia widened the bands under which the rupiah is allowed to move against the dollar.
Malaysia's Bank Negara, the central bank, has sold dollars aggressively to fight off speculators against the ringgit.
